Implementaion Step

STEP_01
System Instalation
The system starts by setting up the core agent environment and preparing all required configurations. This ensures the foundation is ready before any process begins.
STEP_02
Environment Configuration
Key variables and priorities are defined to control how the system behaves. This includes authentication, system roles, and execution rules.
STEP_03
Kernel Activation
The core engine (kernel) is activated, enabling the system to process commands and operate autonomously in a controlled state.
STEP_04
Agent Deployment
The neural agent is deployed and begins executing tasks based on predefined logic, responding dynamically to inputs and system conditions.
